title: Mazungumzo (Theme 10: Kukabiliana na msongo wa mawazo)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child places the mazungumzo in its kind and occasion, explains its uwasilishaji with an example, and presents it with the audience taking part.

floor.prerequisite: Tells a riddle or a story with the formula.
floor.question: Kitendawili! - ?

representations: a recording or a performance of "Watani wa jadi wanatania kuhusu chakula cha jamii zao"
steps: Listen to or read the text.
Explain its uwasilishaji with an example.
contexts: an evening of stories at home

board.do: Watani wa jadi wanatania kuhusu chakula cha jamii zao

board.say: Hii ni mazungumzo ya aina gani, na inatumika lini?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child presents a short piece with the class responding.

listen_for: anaanza moja kwa moja na kisa

misconceptions.repair: Badilisha sauti kulingana na mhusika na hisia.

checks.question: Ni ishara ipi inafaa unapotaja "mlima mrefu"?
